fixes: Single visual loading experience tuned for Android 7 through Android 16.
Adaptive performance tuning for smoother scrolling and reduced frame drops on low-end and modern devices.
Auto Scroll to Top is disabled by default with a Settings toggle and per-screen scroll restoration.
Business/Sales/Stock action cards and info tooltips are mobile-safe and no longer clip text.
Previous Settings directory layer removed and replaced by one stable Settings Center.
Settings grouped into account, business, app preferences, backup, updates and legal subpages.
Search, readable descriptions, native back navigation and one grey-logo footer added without removing working settings logic.
